fields.note: Office/location names come from the Greenhouse offices tree (render_as=tree) and populate <select id='all_locations'>.

notes: The Harness jobs page is a Webflow page that loads Greenhouse directly: jobs?content=true, departments?render_as=tree and offices?render_as=tree. Department/location are <select> controls applied in the browser by the page's own DepartmentAndLocation() JS, not query parameters on the board API. The page only reads a ?location= URL parameter to pre-select the matching option client-side, so membership still comes from the unfiltered board and filtering must be repeated locally.
evidence: same page: .../harnessinc/departments?render_as=tree and .../harnessinc/offices?render_as=tree; <select name='${s}' id='${s}'> template + DepartmentAndLocation(e,t,n) client-side filter
same page: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('location') only pre-selects <select id='all_locations'>
